-- What a client importing `Proof.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.WatchServed` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def etcdstart.watchRegAt (addr : GoString) (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (γr : ReadNames) (R :
    v3rpc.WSrv GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((isGrpcStreamMd addr
        go!"/etcdserverpb.Watch/Watch"
        (v3rpc.watchUp R) fun md => v3rpc.watchSpec R (etcdstart.srvWOf E γr false) (auth.mdTokenOf md)) ∗
      (∃ pw, v3rpc.isWatchServer pw R) ∗ client.srvWLaws (etcdstart.srvWOf E γr false) ∗ ⌜R.s = s ∧ R.E = E⌝)

theorem etcdstart.watchRegAt_persistent (addr : GoString) (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (γr :
    ReadNames) (R : v3rpc.WSrv GF) : Persistent (etcdstart.watchRegAt addr s E γr R)
